schema_notes: Does not overwrite existing reviewed_by attribution (e.g. kenneth-w-christian-phd on procrastination slug).
Sets review_status = 'reviewed' only when current value is not already a reviewed/approved/published status.
sql_proposal:
update public.questions_master
set
  reviewed_by = 'alex-crenshaw-phd',
  reviewed_at = '2026-06-22'::date,
  review_status = case when lower(coalesce(review_status, '')) in ('reviewed', 'approved', 'published') then review_status else 'reviewed' end
